newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-SECOND MATCH FOR NEW WORLD CUP STADIUM IS RUGBY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SECOND MATCH FOR NEW WORLD CUP STADIUM IS RUGBY.

text.p: The second match at the new Stade de France 1998 World Cup soccer stadium will be a rugby union game in the shape of the France-England clash in the Five Nations championship.

The stadium, being built in the Paris suburb of St Denis and due to host several World Cup matches including the July 12 final, will be officially opened with a friendly between France and Spain on January 31.
The opening fixture of the Five Nations championship is scheduled for the following Saturday.
